note: FL2VA: text-to-video with zero images, first- or last-frame with one, first-and-last with two. int8_convrot rather than fp8_scaled (same 21 GB) because fp8 has no native support on Ampere (A6000 is compute 8.6; fp8 needs 8.9+).
Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder. The nvfp4_awq build is 11 GB smaller but NVFP4 is a Blackwell-native format; int8 is the Ampere-safe choice. Swap to nvfp4 only after confirming it loads on an A6000.
Audio VAE. Required: H3 generates synchronized stereo audio, decoded through VAEDecodeAudio.

Turbo distillation LoRA for the FL2VA base, 8 steps instead of ~20. Effectively required for classroom use: it is the difference between a clip finishing while a student watches and one that ties up a GPU for many minutes. The stock ComfyUI H3 template loads this by default.
4-step variant, 768p-tuned. Faster still and lower quality than the 8-step; useful for a quick iterate-then-finalize loop in class.
